mapper.sql: id, warehouse_id, sku_id, qty, lock_qty, recovery_qty, warn_qty, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS productId, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, ps.id AS skuId, ps.dimension_signature AS dimensionSignature, w.id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, s.qty AS qty, s.lock_qty AS lockQty, s.recovery_qty AS recoveryQty, s.warn_qty AS warnQty, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM stock s INNER JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.id = s.sku_id AND ps.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN product_v2 p ON p.id = ps.product_v2_id AND p.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.is_delete = 0
AND p.product_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.productNo}, '%')
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.name}, '%')
AND w.id = #{params.warehouseId}
ORDER BY p.id,ps.color_name,ps.size_name DESC
